title: LRU Replacement Policy (4-way)
constraints: Track the exact recency order of the 4 ways of one cache set.
After reset the order, from least to most recently used, is 0, 1, 2, 3, so `victim = 0`.
On a rising edge with `touch = 1`, way `way` becomes the most recently used. The relative order of the others is unchanged.
`victim` is always the least recently used way (a function of the stored state). Synchronous reset. Must be synthesizable.
hints: Option 1: keep a 2-bit *age* per way (0 = MRU … 3 = LRU). On access, every way younger than the accessed one ages by 1, and the accessed one becomes 0.
Option 2: an ordered list of 4 way numbers. Remove the accessed way and append it at the MRU end.
The victim is the way with age 3 (or the head of the list).
